background_story: In a mystical realm, Kooper was a majestic phoenix born from the ashes of his predecessor. As a young phoenix, he was fragile and vulnerable, but he possessed a fierce determination to rise above his humble beginnings. Kooper spent years honing his skills, learning to harness the power of the elements and master the ancient magic that coursed through his veins. As he grew stronger, his plumage transformed into a dazzling array of colors, and his wingspan expanded, casting a shadow over the land. When a great calamity struck the realm, Kooper's time had come. He spread his wings and took to the skies, unleashing a fiery storm that purged the darkness and brought new life to the land. From the ashes, Kooper had risen, reborn as a powerful symbol of hope and renewal.

If Kooper masters ancient magic or harnesses elemental power (or both), then he brings renewal to the land.
